summary: Comprehensive Step 0 architectural blueprint and implementation plan for LittleSteps covering workspace inspection, modular Express + SQLite architecture, 8 age groups and 6 learning domains, normalized relational database schema, Parent/Reviewer/Admin RBAC and user journeys, Warm Calm Montessori Editorial design system, child video privacy and 30-day retention controls, and a 5-milestone phased delivery roadmap.
